title: Olfactory Emergence: Smell from the R19 Jamming Switch and Measured DNA γ
abstract: Smell emerges from the inherited R19 switch and measured DNA γ; identity is a combinatorial code over the receptor bank, the transduction switch is shared with rod vision, and the odorant key is a named open problem. Disease chapters are direction-only.
